text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- In an address opening a new session of parliament on Tuesday, King Hussein to touch on local, regional and international issues in his comprehensive speech
- Royal decree inviting parliament to convene on Tuesday.
- Arrest of vagrant with 40,000 dinars ($56,497) in his account.
- Al-Faisali sports club cancels its decision to freeze its activities.
- King Hussein receives al-Batikhi (head of intelligence) and Ababneh (head of the airforce) and a number of intelligence officers and airforce chiefs to congratulate him on his birthday.
- Justice Minister says release of the detainees pardoned recently to start next week and in batches.
- A heated parliamentary session full of stances and decisions, four parliamentary blocs and some independents announce support for the existing Parliamentary Speaker.
- British Lewis group plans a five star hotel in Aqaba.
